events.description: The initial Git comparison used a relative publication path while the command working directory was /tmp. Git failed before reading a source body; the returned exception output was tool-truncated and its full text was not retained. No source or historical body credit is claimed. The comparison is being repeated with an absolute repository location.

SOURCE-EXTENSION2 registered state.rs 430-485 although actual EOF is 479; SOURCE-DISPLAY-M retains the overlong header and actual 430-479 bytes. This state section is not credited there; SOURCE-CORRECTION-REGISTRATION and SOURCE-DISPLAY-N register and redisplay exact 430-479. The separately displayed raised section in M was in range.

qualification: These records preserve the failure and correct subsequent chronology; no checkpoint3821 or runtime claim follows.
